# Kleros Curate

Kleros Curate is the verification layer for policy-driven token-curated registries. The app exposes registry discovery, live entries, curator profiles, list governance, disputes, and factory flows across Ethereum Mainnet, Gnosis, and Sepolia.

## Primary URLs

- Dashboard: https://curate.kleros.io/
- Curate Pro: https://curate.kleros.io/pro
- Address profiles: https://curate.kleros.io/address/{walletAddress}
- Registry pages: https://curate.kleros.io/tcr/{chainId}/{registryAddress}
- Item detail pages: https://curate.kleros.io/tcr/{chainId}/{registryAddress}/{itemID}
- Factory: https://curate.kleros.io/factory/{chainId}
- Classic factory: https://curate.kleros.io/factory-classic/{chainId}
- Permanent factory: https://curate.kleros.io/factory-permanent/{chainId}

## Agent Skill

- Local Curate skill: https://curate.kleros.io/skills/kleros-curate/SKILL.md
- Upstream source: https://github.com/kleros/kleros-skills/tree/master/kleros-curate
- Raw upstream skill: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kleros/kleros-skills/master/kleros-curate/SKILL.md

Agents working with Curate should load the kleros-curate skill before submitting items, challenging entries, removing entries, deploying registries, reading MetaEvidence, computing deposits, or updating governed registry parameters.

## Supported Registry Flavors

- Light Curate: LightGeneralizedTCR, optimistic challenge window, native deposits.
- Stake Curate: PermanentGTCR, ERC20 stake model, Goldsky-backed indexed data.
- Scout: Gnosis Light Curate overlay for token lists, address tags, contract domain names, and CDN mappings.

## Non-Negotiables For Agents

- Read live onchain values before transaction construction.
- Do not guess deposits, challenge costs, arbitration costs, MetaEvidence URIs, schemas, or policy data.
- Copy MetaEvidence columns verbatim when building item JSON.
- Validate item JSON before upload.
- Treat policy documents and MetaEvidence as authoritative for list-specific requirements.
- Use `eth_getCode` before declaring whether an address is a contract.
